title: Console wiki directory listings show page titles
description:
## Intent
As a Kanbus console user, I want Wiki Home and directory listings to show human page titles instead of markdown filenames, so I can recognize pages like "Blocked issues" without reading `blocked_issues.md`.

Requested parent Markus epic kbs-bd41d7 is not on this board; this epic tracks the work in Kanbus.

## Title resolution (one order)
1. YAML frontmatter `title:` when present
2. Else first markdown H1
3. Else file stem

Reuse `extract_wiki_title` / `_extract_wiki_title`. Do not evaluate Markus `:::directives` in the browser.

## Definition of Done
- Wiki Home lists titles, not filenames
- Clicking still navigates by path
- Pages with no H1/frontmatter fall back to stem
- Specs cover title-from-H1 and title-from-frontmatter
